# load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```

# load data

## Daily rainfall_daily data

```{r}
rainfall_daily <- read_csv("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Rainfall_estimation/Daily_1979_2020/10_4231_6YK1-CQ13/Uganda/entebbe_climate_cfsr.csv")
```

# Process data

```{r}
# Add variable labels
rainfall_daily <- rainfall_daily %>%
    rename(
        date = date,
        prcpmm = prcpmm,
        tmin_c = tmin_c,
        tmax_c = tmax_c
    )

## Convert date to date format
rainfall_daily$date <- as.Date(data$date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Create filtered datasets
rainfall20 <- rainfall_daily %>% filter(prcpmm > 20, prcpmm <= 40)
rainfall40 <- rainfall_daily %>% filter(prcpmm > 40, prcpmm <= 60)
rainfall60 <- rainfall_daily %>% filter(prcpmm > 60, prcpmm <= 80)
rainfall80 <- rainfall_daily %>% filter(prcpmm > 80, prcpmm <= 100)
rainfall100 <- rainfall_daily %>% filter(prcpmm > 100)
```

# Plot Daily data

```{r}
# Plot
p1_daily = ggplot(rainfall_daily, aes(x = date, y = prcpmm, color = prcpmm)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "red") +
    labs(
        title = "Daily rainfall_daily in Entebbe, Uganda 1979-2020",
        x = "Date",
        y = "rainfall_daily (mm)"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 120, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 80, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 60, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 40, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 160, 20)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank()
    )

# Create table with counts of rainfall_daily days above specified thresholds
    rainfall_counts <- data.frame(
    Threshold = c("20 mm", "40 mm", "60 mm", "80 mm", "100 mm"),
    Count = c(
        nrow(rainfall20),
        nrow(rainfall40),
        nrow(rainfall60),
        nrow(rainfall80),
        nrow(rainfall100)
    )
)

p2_daily = ggtexttable(rainfall_counts)

# Combine plot and table
plot <- ggarrange(p1, p2,
ncol = 1, nrow = 2,
heights = c(10,3))

plot

# Save plot
ggsave("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Plots/Rainfall_Entebbe_daily.png", plot, width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

## Hourly rainfall_daily data
```{r}
# load the data
hourly_rain <- read.csv("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Rainfall_estimation/Hourly_kamp/data/shear_rain.csv")

# Create total rainfall_daily variable
hourly_rain$Total_rainfall <- apply(hourly_rain[, c("ACTogether.HQ", "Makerere", "MengoSS", "RC.ClimateCentre", "RC.Warehouse")], 1, sum)

# set X as a time variable
hourly_rain$X <- as.POSIXct(hourly_rain$X, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# Create a line plot of the total rainfall_daily with color based on intensity
p1 = ggplot(hourly_rain, aes(x = X, y = Total_rainfall, color = Total_rainfall)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = seq(20, 200, by = 20), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "Hourly rainfall_daily in Kampala (April 2019 - March 2020)", x = "Time", y = "Total rainfall_daily (mm)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank()) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall), by = 20)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "red")

# Create a table that shows the total rainfall_daily per category (0-20, 20-40, 40-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100+)

# Create a new variable that categorizes the total rainfall_daily
hourly_rain$Rainfall_category <- cut(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall, breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, Inf), labels = c("0-20", "20-40", "40-60", "60-80", "80-100", "100+"))

# Create a table that shows the total rainfall_daily per category
p2 = table(hourly_rain$Rainfall_category)

p2 <- ggtexttable(data.frame(p2), cols = c("rainfall_daily in mm category", "Count"))

# Combine the plot and the table
ggarrange(p1, p2, ncol = 1, nrow = 2, heights = c(10, 3))

```

### Create 3-hour and 6-hour totals 
####
Create 3-hour totals
```{r}
# Create 3-hour totals
hourly_rain$three_hour_totals <- hourly_rain$Total_rainfall + dplyr::lag(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall, n = 1, default = 0) + dplyr::lag(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall, n = 2, default = 0)

# Create a line plot of the 3-hour totals with color based on intensity
p3 = ggplot(hourly_rain, aes(x = X, y = three_hour_totals, color = three_hour_totals)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = seq(20, 200, by = 20), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "3-Hour rainfall_daily Totals in Kampala (April 2019 - March 2020)", x = "Time", y = "3-Hour rainfall_daily Total (mm)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank()) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(hourly_rain$three_hour_totals), by = 20)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "red")

# Create a table that shows the 3-hourly total rainfall_daily per category (0-20, 20-40, 40-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100+)
# Create a new variable that categorizes the 3-hourly total rainfall_daily
hourly_rain$Three_hour_category <- cut(hourly_rain$three_hour_totals, breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, Inf), labels = c("0-20", "20-40", "40-60", "60-80", "80-100", "100+"))

# Create a table that shows the 3-hourly total rainfall_daily per category
p4 <- table(hourly_rain$Three_hour_category)

p4 <- ggtexttable(data.frame(p4), cols = c("rainfall_daily in mm category", "Count"))

# Combine the plot and the table
ggarrange(p3, p4, ncol = 1, nrow = 2, heights = c(10, 3))


```

#### Create 6-hour totals
```{r}
# Create 6-hour totals
hourly_rain$six_hour_totals <- hourly_rain$Total_rainfall + dplyr::lag(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall, n = 1, default = 0) + dplyr::lag(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall, n = 2, default = 0) + dplyr::lag(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall, n = 3, default = 0) + dplyr::lag(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall, n = 4, default = 0) + dplyr::lag(hourly_rain$Total_rainfall, n = 5, default = 0)

# Create a line plot of the 6-hour totals with color based on intensity
p5 = ggplot(hourly_rain, aes(x = X, y = six_hour_totals, color = six_hour_totals)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = seq(20, 200, by = 20), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "6-Hour rainfall_daily Totals in Kampala (April 2019 - March 2020)", x = "Time", y = "6-Hour rainfall_daily Total (mm)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank()) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(hourly_rain$six_hour_totals), by = 20)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "red")

# Create a table that shows the 6-hourly total rainfall_daily per category (1-6, 2-7, 3-8, etc.)
# Create a new variable that categorizes the 6-hourly total rainfall_daily
hourly_rain$Six_hour_category <- cut(hourly_rain$six_hour_totals, breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, Inf), labels = c("0-20", "20-40", "40-60", "60-80", "80-100", "100+"))

# Create a table that shows the 6-hourly total rainfall_daily per category
p6 <- table(hourly_rain$Six_hour_category)

p6 <- ggtexttable(data.frame(p6), cols = c("rainfall_daily in mm category", "Count"))

# Combine the plot and the table
ggarrange(p5, p6, ncol = 1, nrow = 2, heights = c(10, 3))

```

#### Combine all plots and tables
```{r}
# Combine the 1-hour, 3-hour, and 6-hour plots and tables
ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, ncol = 1, nrow = 6, widths = c(5, 1.5), heights = c(10, 4))

```
